dedupe_keys.name: emissions by plant and by region

description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration lists two annual spreadsheet series for electricity-sector emissions: one organised by power plant and one by geographical region. Both cover carbon dioxide, sulphur dioxide and nitrogen oxides. The inspected landing page lists 2013–2024 files, extending beyond the older coverage shown by the general survey-data directory. The page links to the Electric Power Data Guide for definitions. Plant-level emissions can supply historical reference values for electricity-generation and emissions scenarios, while regional files provide aggregates for comparison. They do not by themselves establish marginal emissions factors, hourly dispatch, causal effects or a ready-to-run power-system model. The two geographical scopes and their aggregation should be checked before combining them with EIA generation data. Access is free through the public download directory. EIA states that its government publications are public domain and requests acknowledgement. Caveats: only landing-page metadata was inspected; no spreadsheets or archives were downloaded, and field completeness and units remain unverified. Related resources are the EIA survey catalogues.
